selection: Two registered videos and seed 0 are fixed before labels; no video, threshold, memory mode or outer metric selection.
hypothesis: The independent six-video-exposed fish-trained RGB post-neck coordinate may correct source-matched DINO embedding decisions on the same causal graph, despite its historical exposure.
predeclared_margin_gate: Use legacy RGB only when its appearance-cost top-two margin is strictly greater than the DINO embedding margin; otherwise retain DINO embedding. No fitted threshold.
promotion_gate: Expand to all six videos and three corresponding legacy seeds only if both pilot videos have legacy-RGB corrections greater than harms and positive fixed-margin correction-minus-harm; otherwise preserve a negative or mixed boundary and run no combination.
scope: Read-only same-input candidate-edge complementarity pilot. DINO FIFO predictions must remain byte-identical; legacy RGB is a retrospective alternative coordinate over the unchanged proposal graph. The legacy encoder was trained with all six train videos, so any positive result is conditional and cannot establish unseen-video generalization.

guards.gpu_feature_extraction: No new feature extraction; existing causal post-neck RGB bank is reused by exact manifest/hash.
